newsitem.title: UK: Blair orders official history of Falklands War.
newsitem.headline: Blair orders official history of Falklands War.

text.p: Prime Minister Tony Blair has commissioned an academic to write an official history of the 1982 war in which British troops evicted Argentine forces from the disputed Falkland Islands.

"I have appointed Professor Lawrence Freedman, Head of War Studies at Kings College, London...to write the official history of the Falklands campaign," Blair said on Friday in a written answer to a parliamentary question.

Freedman, 48, has already written two books on the Falklands War. About 1,000 people were killed as a British task force expelled Argentine forces which had invaded the wind-swept archipelago in the South Atlantic.
Despite its defeat and the opposition of most of the islands' 2,500 residents, Buenos Aires continues to press its 150-year-old claim to sovereignty.
